Arch Linux advisory and native version fixtures
=============================================
Retrieved over verified HTTPS on 2026-10-10. These are retained vendor observations,
not evidence of acquisition freshness for a later offline import. No package
transaction, installed host inventory or live advisory refresh is claimed here.

  Requested https://security.archlinux.org/all.json
  Final URL https://security.archlinux.org/issues/all.json
  Original response: 898937 bytes
  SHA-256: 0eb3e86e8f94aa05374e30d1feb3e59bdfe99f2f52f62176ca522fbe3c546950
  Observed statuses: Fixed 2151, Not affected 193, Vulnerable 85, Unknown 15.

arch-backport.json:
  SHA-256: 5dea1441db2bf97d37d68182ed68dfb283bdb3d03d77b36914f30088fb144a4e
  Exact AVG-1530 JSON object bytes selected from that response, surrounded by
  '[' and ']\n' to retain the vendor array format. Object keys, whitespace,
  values and order are not reserialized or changed.
  Package wpa_supplicant, affected 2:2.9-7, fixed 2:2.9-8,
  CVE-2021-0326, High, Fixed; reference ASA-202102-25.
  This is a genuine same-upstream pkgrel backport, not a fabricated semver case.

arch-statuses.json:
  SHA-256: f8317483839bb9cb7610671ff658660b1a6c9bdb6ca134a26aa06e471b79e033
  Exact selected object byte spans in original response order, joined with ','
  and surrounded by '[' and ']\n'. Selection is only by these AVG identifiers:
  AVG-2843: vim, Unknown, affected 9.0.1224-1, fixed field 9.0.1225-1.
    A populated fixed field must not override Unknown assessment status.
  AVG-2907: djvulibre, Vulnerable, affected 3.5.28-6, no fixed version.
  AVG-2737: gnome-remote-desktop, Not affected; its fixed field does not make it
    a vulnerability. No general clean-package assertion follows this one CVE.
  AVG-2821: zlib, Fixed, 1:1.2.12-2 -> 1:1.2.12-3, CVE-2022-37434.
    Another real epoch/pkgrel fix; no published ASA or date in the issue export.

arch-advisories.json:
  SHA-256: 5993681600011be625dc66ef766130b2a11a2f4c31222c61ecdbfe1e3fd21872
  Exact ASA-202102-25 object byte span, wrapped in '[' and ']\n' as above.
  Explicit group AVG-1530, package wpa_supplicant and date 2021-02-12.
  Publication enrichment joins both group and package, never merely a CVE.
  Missing entries leave publication absent. Calendar dates are represented at
  UTC midnight without claiming an observed time of day. The tracker derives
  both JSON date and Atom published from Advisory.created for published ASAs;
  it does not expose a separate actual release-event timestamp in this export.

arch-ASA-202102-25.txt:
  https://security.archlinux.org/ASA-202102-25/raw
  Exact original response: 1420 bytes
  SHA-256: b34fe7b6af96984a03793a0902a5632b547cd9109d52f0cebcd42a3d6a66bfa6
  Authoritative text explicitly says versions before 2:2.9-8 are vulnerable,
  upgrade to 2:2.9-8, and "The problem has been fixed upstream but no release
  is available yet." It supplies date 2021-02-12. This document is retained as
  independent explanatory evidence, not silently substituted into JSON input.

Native version semantics and vectors:
  Pacman v7.0.0 commit 138cbae58448b7fde90335526add3029875784ee
  Tag object 1099fc2ecf4b7816b50381358a33ad03af510f15
  Tag identity retrieved from:
  https://gitlab.archlinux.org/api/v4/projects/pacman%2Fpacman/repository/tags/v7.0.0
arch-vercmptest.txt:
  https://gitlab.archlinux.org/pacman/pacman/-/raw/138cbae58448b7fde90335526add3029875784ee/test/util/vercmptest.sh
  Exact original response: 3207 bytes
  SHA-256: dfe61f66ef31756f7b02a045c0ab396bfa6dfb30c12e27fbaac849f650e62061
  All 46 literal tap_runtest cases are read as data, plus their reversals,
  producing the upstream 92 comparison assertions. The shell file is not run.
  Copyright (c) 2009-2024 Pacman Development Team and (c) 2008 Dan McGee.
  GNU GPL version 2 or, at the recipient's option, any later version; original
  copyright/license notice retained verbatim in the fixture.
  The Go comparator implements the observed libalpm ordering, without C string
  copies: epoch first, separator counts, numeric/alpha runs, trailing alpha vs
  empty suffix, and pkgrel only when both versions include it. No modern RPM
  tilde/caret semantics or dpkg revision defaulting are substituted.
  Comparator reference (not vendored):
  https://gitlab.archlinux.org/pacman/pacman/-/raw/138cbae58448b7fde90335526add3029875784ee/lib/libalpm/version.c
  6771 bytes; SHA-256:
  28ee2f7ee82e5f526c1179c800688bdaa097c0f36a0df190f770d13c0a64a552
  https://man.archlinux.org/man/core/pacman/vercmp.8.en

Coverage and schema provenance:
  https://archlinux.org/about/ describes official Arch as x86-64 and rolling.
  This parser accepts only arch/rolling/x86_64 sources, not Manjaro,
  Arch Linux ARM, historical i686, AUR or third-party repository coverage.
  The vendor issues export has no repository or package architecture fields.
  Per-package architecture and source/binary mappings are not synthesized.
  All Arch documents remain incomplete even at the canonical endpoint:
  absence of a finding is UNKNOWN, never evidence that every package is clean.
  Vulnerable and Testing entries establish only the exact known affected build;
  a populated fixed field can name an unreleased or testing-only fix. It does
  not establish that the fix reached stable repositories. Unknown remains an
  explicitly undetermined assessment regardless of a populated fixed field.
  Fixed entries use the vendor fixed upper bound, not affected as an invented
  introduction version. Not affected entries retain that explicit assessment.

  Upstream tracker commit a18d5c9d8291bf4eeb21b450eca77c62c8c006f9:
  https://github.com/archlinux/arch-security-tracker/commit/a18d5c9d8291bf4eeb21b450eca77c62c8c006f9
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archlinux/arch-security-tracker/a18d5c9d8291bf4eeb21b450eca77c62c8c006f9/tracker/view/index.py
  get_index_data defaults only_in_repo=True and joins its Package cache;
  index_json exports the fields captured above and no publication date.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archlinux/arch-security-tracker/a18d5c9d8291bf4eeb21b450eca77c62c8c006f9/tracker/view/advisory.py
  advisory_json includes published entries only and formats created as a date;
  advisory_atom also uses created for published. Scheduled entries are not
  publication evidence. This source was inspected, not vendored.
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/archlinux/arch-security-tracker/a18d5c9d8291bf4eeb21b450eca77c62c8c006f9/tracker/model/enum.py
  status_to_affected classifies both Vulnerable and Testing as affected.
  affected_to_status allows a populated fixed version with Vulnerable if the
  latest repository version is still below it, and derives Testing when all
  repository builds at or beyond the fix are in testing repositories.

  Arch advisory facts/text remain attributed to the Arch Linux Security Team.
  No blanket advisory-data redistribution license was established by these
  endpoints. Review redistribution rights before public distribution, alongside
  the retained GPL upstream vector fixture and product licensing decision.
